description: Historical Plans - Metropolitan Sewerage Scheme (SRO-001) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by State Records Office of Western Australia. Historical survey plans created by the Metropolitan Water Works Board (and successor departments) in preparation for a sewerage scheme for the Perth metropolitan area. The original plans were transferred to the State Archives Collection in the 1980's and were digitised and geo-referenced between 2016-2019. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher State Records Office of Western Australia. Its tags are History, properties, sewerage, survey. It offers 6 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, csv, pdf, tif, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
